explication: Crawlab is a distributed crawler-management platform: users manage spiders and schedules through a web UI and master-hosted API; the master schedules tasks to workers, which run crawler processes and store logs and results. The architecture also includes node management, authentication, statistics, exports, notifications, and configurable data sources. Relationships are grounded in the README and the supplied source index or excerpts; some unsampled subsystem internals are shown only at the documented level.
